_comment: Interactive menu bot. Each flow: trigger (keywords) starts it; steps drive the conversation. Step keys: send[] (messages to send on entry), options[] (wait for a reply, branch by match/number), collect (save the reply into a variable, then go next), next (auto-advance after sending), end (finish), fallback (reply when no option matches). Send item types: text, image, video, document, voice. Variables like {{name}} and collected vars like {{question}} work in text/caption.

send.text:
Hi {{name}}! 👋 How can we help you today?

1️⃣ Our products
2️⃣ Talk to support
3️⃣ Opening hours

_Reply with a number._

Great choice! Here's our latest catalog 📦
Reply *menu* anytime to start over.
